annotation: Beitrag zur Sammlung »The Progress of English Poetry« (INr 130152, Obj 15)
incipit_statement: Ye daintie Nymphs, that in this blessed brooke, / do bathe your brest, / Forsake your watrie bowres and hither looke, / at my request
preferred_title: an Aeglogue to the honour and praise of Queene / Elizabeth
